    When you make an Ability Check with a Skill you are Proficient with, the lowest result you can roll on the die is 10.

LOW_Guildhall_BossFriol
Boss Friol is the Rock Gnome leader of the Zhentarim found in Act Three, if  Roah Moonglow had been killed earlier in the game.

Overview

She is found conspiring with  Bhaal cultists and a brainwashed  Minsc in the Lower City Sewers after encountering Minsc in the The Counting House. She is immediately hostile to the party.

Even though she says in dialogue that she must flee in order to launch a raid on The Guild, she sometimes stays and fights the party.
